# Instituto Cervantes Los Ángeles

> > Official Spanish language and Hispanic culture institution in Los Angeles, promoting Spanish language education, DELE certification, and cultural exchange since 1991.

Instituto Cervantes Los Ángeles is part of the worldwide network of Spanish Government cultural centers dedicated to teaching Spanish language, administering DELE certification exams, and promoting Hispanic cultures including Spanish, Catalan, and Basque traditions. The center serves the California region with courses, teacher training, digital library resources, and cultural programming.
